verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Calendly shipping its own MCP *server* (tools like event_types-create_event_type) for other AI agents to call, not Calendly acting as an MCP *client* that plugs in third-party MCP servers to use their tools. No documentation, product page, or community report mentions Calendly consuming external MCP servers or extending its AI assistant (Callie) with pluggable MCP tool sources.
